name: deliver
description: Value-aligned SDLC execution with Sol routing, one optimal worker, Opus verification, and Sol synthesis

tasks.prompt: Interactively impossible in headless mode: build complete evidence-backed SPEC-TS ledger from objective/repository. Return NEEDS_INPUT/BLOCK if decision-changing Scope, Requirements, Constraints or Success Metrics are missing. Otherwise PASS with versioned ledger and measurable goal. Objective: {{objective}}

Create Design Pass 1 candidate implementation approach from SPEC-TS: contracts, components/files, dependency order, allowed/protected paths, tests, telemetry, security, rollout/rollback and one recommended worker. Inputs: {{dependencies}}

Perform Design Pass 2: challenge candidate against alternative, failure/security/data/operations/cost/evolution/value, simplify and freeze approved plan. Return BLOCK/NEEDS_INPUT if invalid. Inputs: {{dependencies}}

Verify Gate 1 alignment and Gate 2 design/task readiness. If both PASS, choose exactly one worker and emit exactly one handoff agent work-luna/work-sonnet/work-k3/work-glm with strict allowed_paths, frozen SPEC-TS/design revision, acceptance, success metrics, parent/CI checks and stop conditions. Inputs: {{dependencies}}

Implement once: approved frozen SPEC-TS/Design Pass 2 contract as sole writer. Preserve allowed paths, non-goals, success metrics, stop directives and human gates. Do not execute commands or self-verify. Gate package: {{dependencies}}

Own Gate 3. Independently verify same SPEC-TS/design revision, implementation scope, value, acceptance, architecture, security, quality, operations, success metrics and changed source. Refute unsupported claims. Return HANDOFF_READY only when coherent; BLOCK/NEEDS_INPUT/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE otherwise. Inputs: {{dependencies}}

Compare harness checks and Gate 3 evidence with SPEC-TS Success Metrics. Return GOAL_MET only when checks passed and measurable goal evidence supports it; otherwise PARTIAL_VALUE/BLOCK/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Synthesize value, source changes, evidence, residual risk, human gates and next smallest action. Never overclaim released/deployed. Inputs: {{dependencies}}
